verdict.rationale: Kick documents its own CLI for terminal-based lookups and reports, and says MCP or CLI can automate month-end checks across workspaces. That is a first-party, non-UI automation surface. A Bearer-token Platform API also exists, but it is gated per organization, and nothing documents CI pipeline use or unattended operation. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive or service-token auth for the CLI, CI/pipeline examples or guidance, a publicly available API, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Run accounting lookups and reports from your terminal. Authenticate, pick a workspace, and pull transactions or financial statements with the Kick CLI.
Connect MCP or CLI to take it further: query your client data in plain language, automate month-end checks, and build workflows that run across every workspace.
The Platform API is not yet publicly available. Access is enabled per organization by the Kick team.
